item.title: CKB Talk Daily Brief - 2026-08-14
item.description: ## 今日发生了什么 过去 24 小时，Nervos Talk 上最热闹的是一件事：CKB Governance 投票协议的讨论中，有成员直接质疑另一位的回帖是未经整理就粘贴的 AI 生成内容，随后引发了一场关于内容格式与技术讨论有效性的争论 [S02, S03, S04]。与此同时，Spark Program 委员会密集处理了多个提案，既有新项目获批、也有项目被调整预算或被拒绝 [S14, S15, S19, S23, S24]。 ## 重点话题 **CKB Governance 帖子出现"AI 生成内容"质疑**：yixiu.ckbfans.bit 指出 tianji 的回复中残留着转义符 `\`，认为这是直接从 AI 助手输出复制粘贴且未检查格式的结果 [S03]。tianji 随后回应，承认格式缺陷确实存在（Markdown 控制字符在转义过程中出错），但认为这不应与审查内容的技术有效性混为一谈 [S04]。另一成员 zz_tovarishch 也表示社区对 AI 辅助持开放态度，但缺乏工程判断的"文本倾倒"只会增加讨论噪音 [S02]。 **Spark Program 多个项目同日更新决定**：Fiber RGB++ Swap 被委员会认定 RGB++ 协议集成部分超出资助范围，预算调整为 $500，Carl 已接受新范围并提交了 4 周的分周预算计划 [S14, S15, S16]，委员会随后要求其提供收款地址、邮箱和 Discord 以发放 609,757 CKB [S17]。CKB-VM Sail Validation Sprint...

item.title: CKB Governance: cell-native DAO voting protocol on testnet (create poll question, vote, delegate, aggregate & close ) (4 posts)
item.description: The review has correctly identified the immediate implementation defects. The remaining problem is deeper: the protocol has not yet defined what close is allowed to certify. At present, the contract can prove that the tally is correct over the intents actually consumed by aggregation. It cannot prove that the consumed set is the complete set of valid timely intents. That distinction is not cosmetic: correct tally over selected inputs ≠ complete tally ≠ admissible governance result Why the current fixes do not establish completeness Requiring finalized shard IDs to be adjacent and to cover 0..shard_count-1 would prevent omission of an entire tally lane. item.title: Spark Program | CKB Wallet Behaviour Intelligence (2 posts)
item.description: Hi @mulinya, The committee reviewed your latest update. The methodology contains a fatal weakness. The static threshold using transaction volume is an invalid boundary for human and bot activity. User transaction counts naturally grow over time and cross this boundary. This approach lacks meaning for blockchain behavior analysis. Valuable machine learning must focus on dynamic behavioral patterns and asset flow characteristics. The system needs to mine complex structures like loop transactions, fixed high-frequency intervals, and fund distribution networks. The current data extraction limits prevent the observation of these temporal network features. We provide one final opportunity to...

item.title: Spark Program | Cellar — A Capacity Leasing Market for CKB Cells (2 posts)
item.description: The payload would not necessarily be unauthenticated. Cellar can require every creation and update transaction to include an ordinary borrower-signed input, then verify that input’s lock hash against the borrower identity stored in the lease. This proves the payload was authorized by that borrower. What Cellar cannot prove is that the payload is correct or canonical application state. Anyone could still create another lease containing fake-looking data, so readers would need an external anchor such as a trusted borrower identity, registry entry, or expected data hash. I also agree that witness data is better when the data is only needed by one transaction. A leased cell is useful only...

item.description: Hi @Akane, Thank you for submitting the proposal. item.title: Spark Program | Corven — Cloud Development Platform for the CKB Ecosystem (1 posts)
item.description: Hi @lestonEth, Thank you for submitting the proposal. After evaluation, the committee has decided to decline funding for this application at its current scope. Scope & Program Fit: Building a full-fledged cloud IDE platform is a heavy infrastructure initiative that exceeds the lightweight scope and budget bounds of the Spark Program. Given the scale and resource demands of this concept, we encourage you to refine the architecture and apply through the CKB Community Fund DAO, which is...

item.title: FiberSplit — Automated Subscription Splitting on Fiber (1 posts)
item.description: Hi @SalmanDev, Thank you for submitting the proposal. After reviewing the details, the committee has decided to decline funding for FiberSplit at this stage. Architectural Mismatch: The underlying architecture of Fiber payment channels and session permissions does not fit cleanly with the actual operational and state management requirements of group billing split flows. item.description: Hi @Carl, Thank you for submitting the proposal. After a thorough review, the committee has decided to decline funding for JoyID Connect at this stage. item.description: ckb的采用，是指机构级采用，还是指散户demo？ Linux 先有个人与社区，后有 IBM；Kubernetes 先有 Google，后扩散到社区；PostgreSQL 先有伯克利，后进入产业。开源项目从来没有固定的采用顺序 不同的采用层级也从来不是非此即彼的选择题 这条讨论因为没有和具体的事项挂钩，我先锁定它了
